com.vector.cfg.automation.api.project

Interface ICreateProjectVirtualTargetApi


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
 @PublishedFilter(value=MsrPlatform.class)
 @NotThreadSafe
public interface ICreateProjectVirtualTargetApi
    ICreateProjectVirtualTargetApi provides means for specifying the new project's vVIRTUALtarget settings.
    The ICreateProjectVirtualTargetApi contains the methods for specifying the new project's vVIRTUALtarget settings. The vVIRTUALtarget support may not be available depending on the purchased license.

      • setCreateVirtualTargetProjectFile

        @PublishedMethod
void setCreateVirtualTargetProjectFile(boolean createVirtualTargetProjectFile)
        Specifies whether or not to create a vVIRTUALtarget project file for the new project.
        Create vVIRTUALtarget project file
        setCreateVirtualTargetProjectFile(boolean) specifies whether or not to create a vVIRTUALtarget project file for the new project. This is an optional parameter defaulting to true. However the vVIRTUALtarget project file is only created when ICreateProjectTargetApi.vVIRTUALtargetSupport(boolean) evaluates to true.
        Parameters:
        createVirtualTargetProjectFile - whether or not to create a vVIRTUALtarget project file for the new project

      • setVirtualTargetExecutable

        @PublishedMethod
void setVirtualTargetExecutable(@Nonnull
                                                  java.lang.Object virtualTargetExecutable)
        Sets the vVIRTUALtarget executable (VttCmd.exe) for the new project.
        vVIRTUALtarget Executable
        Set the vVIRTUALtarget executable (VttCmd.exe) for the new project with setVirtualTargetExecutable(Object). This is an optional parameter defaulting to the location of the currently registered installation (if there is any) if the parameter is not provided explicitly.

        The value given here is converted to Path using ScriptConverters.TO_SCRIPT_PATH .

        Parameters:
        virtualTargetExecutable - the vVIRTUALtarget executable (VttCmd.exe) for the new project

      • setVirtualTargetProject

        @PublishedMethod
void setVirtualTargetProject(@Nonnull
                                               java.lang.Object virtualTargetProject)
        Sets the vVIRTUALtarget project (*.vttproj) for the new project.
        vVIRTUALtarget Project
        Set the path to the vVIRTUALtarget project (*.vttproj) for the new project with setVirtualTargetProject(Object). This is an optional parameter defaulting to './Config/VTT/ProjectName.vttproj' if the parameter is not provided explicitly. See also ICreateProjectTargetApi.setvVIRTUALtargetSupport(boolean) and setCreateVirtualTargetProjectFile(boolean) at which both have to be true to force the creation of the vVIRTUALtarget project.

        The value given here is converted to Path using ScriptConverters.TO_SCRIPT_PATH .

        Parameters:
        virtualTargetProject - the vVIRTUALtarget executable (VttCmd.exe) for the new project
